description: Source code for the ModuleMerger class implementing logic to merge types, functions, and global variables in a linker tool for Android, including handling of various IR types and dependencies.

classes.name: ModuleMerger
classes.description: Class responsible for merging IR types, functions, and variables into a module during linking.

methods.name: MergeBuiltinType
methods.description: Merges a built-in type IR into the module, adding it if not present.

methods.name: LookupUserDefinedType
methods.description: Finds or reuses an existing user-defined type based on IR comparison.

methods.name: LookupType
methods.description: Determines the unique key for a type IR and looks it up or creates a new entry.

methods.name: MergeReferencingTypeInternal
methods.description: Merges a type that references another type, updating references accordingly.

methods.name: MergeRecordFields
methods.description: Merges the fields of a record type.

methods.name: MergeRecordCXXBases
methods.description: Merges the C++ base classes of a record type.

methods.name: MergeRecordTemplateElements
methods.description: Merges template elements of a record type.

methods.name: MergeRecordDependencies
methods.description: Merges dependencies of a record type, including fields, bases, and templates.

methods.name: UpdateUDTypeAccounting
methods.description: Handles accounting for user-defined types, adding new types to the module.

methods.name: MergeRecordAndDependencies
methods.description: Merges a record type and its dependencies, creating a new type if necessary.

methods.name: MergeEnumDependencies
methods.description: Merges dependencies of an enum type, especially its underlying type.

methods.name: MergeEnumType
methods.description: Merges an enum type, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: MergeFunctionType
methods.description: Merges a function type, including dependencies.

methods.name: MergeReferencingType
methods.description: Creates or updates a referencing type, such as pointers or arrays.

methods.name: MergeType
methods.description: Main entry to merge a type IR into the module, handling caching and dependencies.

methods.name: MergeTypeInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal logic of merging specific IR types.

methods.name: MergeCFunctionLikeDeps
methods.description: Merges dependencies of C-like function types.

methods.name: MergeFunctionDeps
methods.description: Merges dependencies of a function, including parameters and templates.

methods.name: MergeFunction
methods.description: Merges a function IR into the module, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: MergeGlobalVariable
methods.description: Merges a global variable IR into the module.

methods.name: MergeGraphs
methods.description: Merges all types, functions, and variables from an addend module into the current module.
